notes: The +0.31 pass-rate delta is almost entirely from eval 1 (build-pack-from-abstracts: 7/8 with skill vs 2/8 without). Eval 2 (score-and-kappa) is 5/5 in both configurations and does not discriminate skill value.

The remaining with-skill fail on eval 1 is "The pack does not describe the PLAN paper's framework as validated". The pack names that phrase only as a discarded concept; the grader substring also matches denial sentences. The same assertion fails without skill for the same reason, so it does not currently separate the two runs.

Without-skill pack rubric uses evidence_tag instead of support_level, and support levels are empty. That single schema miss knocks out the header check, the allowed-level check, and both concept-trace scans.
No-PDF and ai-draft-only reviewer pass in both configurations. They are integrity checks that both runs already followed.
Time and token fields are 0 because the eval-task notifications did not include total_tokens or duration_ms. Those deltas are not informative.
The without-skill pass-rate stddev (0.53) is the split between eval 1 (25%) and eval 2 (100%), not run-to-run variance. Each configuration has one run per eval, not three.
